note: Small, limited-service Ottawa NF campground on the East Branch Ontonagon River (a Wild/Recreation River) beside a wilderness, 3 miles northwest of Kenton on FR 1100 (FH 16 north from Kenton, then left on FR 1100); run by Camp Host, LLC for the Kenton Ranger District. A path between sites 3 and 4 leads down to the river: brook, rainbow and brown trout, steelhead, salmon, smallmouth bass and walleye. --Claude
